* '''Original''' ([[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]]): the card image at official release (1 October 2023)<ref name="ht-2494181">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de 2494181] “Set 22”, 1 October 2023.</ref> prints: “If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force. OR During battle, if Obi-Wan is participating (or ‘communing’), add one battle destiny; characters may not be ‘revived’ this turn. OR Cancel Clash Of Sabers targeting your Dark Jedi.”<ref name="cj-867258b">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/867258b swccg-card-json commit 867258b] “Set 22” (1 October 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 6 October 2023: “If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force. OR During battle, if Obi-Wan is participating (or 'communing'), add one battle destiny; characters may not be 'revived' this turn. OR Cancel Clash Of Sabers targeting your Dark Jedi.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] (published 2 October 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-23b4dc9">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306 23b4dc9] “DS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “USED: During battle, cancel game text of an opponent’s hut or Jedi survivor. LOST: Cancel Clash Of Sabers (targeting your character of ability > 3) or Old Ben. OR Target a Jedi. Target is power -2 for remainder of turn.”<ref name="cj-12dc019">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/12dc019 swccg-card-json commit 12dc019] “Tweak Set 2026 - Dark” (14 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The card became a Used or Lost Interrupt (it was a Lost Interrupt) and was rewritten. Removed: “If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force.” and the Obi-Wan battle-destiny option. New USED option: “During battle, cancel game text of an opponent’s hut or Jedi survivor.” The Clash Of Sabers option became “Cancel Clash Of Sabers (targeting your character of ability > 3) or Old Ben.” (was “targeting your Dark Jedi”), and “OR Target a Jedi. Target is power -2 for remainder of turn.” was added. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
